sources.title: Factor Momentum and the Momentum Factor

methodology.hypothesis: Market beta may dominate momentum in long-only factor funds. Compare total-return ranking with SPY-regression residual ranking while holding aggregate equity/gold target budgets identical.
methodology.score: Reuse the unchanged original factor_scores helper. Total momentum compounds the last126 daily returns excluding the latest21. Residual momentum fits an intercept and SPY excess-return beta on the trailing252 daily returns, then sums the last126 residuals excluding21 divided by their sample standard deviation.
methodology.availability: The verified factor snapshot begins2015-08-10. A252-session daily fit and126-minus21 score permit full pre-account warmup without altering the formal2016-10-06/2021-10-06 return windows. This is a short-window ETF adaptation, not the papers' stock-level multifactor or long-short replication.
methodology.factor_composition: At completed month ends rank all four funds by the selected score, ticker as deterministic tie-breaker. Assign35/30/20/15%of the equity sleeve. No fund is removed, no absolute-return filter is added and no shares are fitted.
methodology.matched_budgets: Reuse the frozen equal-four-factor/gold63-session inverse-volatility baseline with30%-70%equity bounds. Both candidates inherit exactly the same equity total, gold total and decision dates, so score-dependent changes cannot alter aggregate defensive exposure.
methodology.timing: Every score, regression and risk input ends at the signal close. Execute next-session open in base or one additional session in stress. Preserve USD10,000,2%target idle cash,USD1commissions,5/20bp costs and all recurring-program gates.
methodology.interpretation: These are two allocation configurations on four existing economic factor exposures, not new independent alpha families. SPY beta removal in a score does not hedge beta in the long-only holdings. Momentum itself is not independent of the MTUM mandate.
methodology.selection: Formed after100completed configurations on exposed overlapping history. No untouched holdout, parameter grid, fitted shares or live promotion. A historically passing result would still require independent prospective validation.
